topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Well, I must say, I was quite surprised when I received a message from a stranger, showing me photos of a beautiful tattoo that closely resembled one of my illustrations. At first, I was taken aback, thinking about the effort and the intimate decision behind choosing my work to be inked on someone’s skin. But as I looked closer, I saw the care and the artistic touch in the translation from paper to body. It’s an honor, really, to see my art resonate so deeply with someone that they want to carry it with them, a part of their personal story. I sent them a warm message, thanking them for sharing and expressing how much I appreciated seeing my work in such a unique form. It’s moments like these that remind me why I create.
